text:
marta: Heads up — PR #4321 adds an SDK sample for region headers and mentions FIPS-country mapping. Pushed a small tweak, but want legal + i18n eyes before merge.

devon: where's the snippet? link please :eyes:

marta: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321/files. File: docs/guides/geo-sdk-examples.md (bottom). JS + curl examples.

ana: quick note — don't expose internal 'fips' variable in public samples; use `country_code` instead. tiny phrasing change.

ana: also clarify residency vs routing: header indicates preferred region but is not a data residency guarantee. add a sentence.

jin: LGTM from legal but please use exact residency wording we agreed: "Requests routed to a regional endpoint do not imply data residency unless you have a dedicated residency contract with Redwood." Add verbatim.

marta: adding that now.

devon: snippet detail — header should be `X-Redwood-Region` (case preserved). Current example uses `x-region`. I'll update to `X-Redwood-Region` to match SDK enum.

marta: thanks. Also replacing the FIPS mapping with: "We recommend using ISO 3166 alpha-2 codes (e.g., US, GB). Some customers map older FIPS codes internally — we don't accept FIPS as canonical input in the public API."

docs-bot: Deploy preview built for PR #4321: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood/4321

ana: can we add a minimal cURL example? Many users copy curl directly. 1-2 lines.

marta: added curl and marked JS as "advanced". New snippet:
```bash
curl -H 'X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1' \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

jin: please insert the residency sentence directly above that curl so legal wording is visible.

marta: done and pushed, also added a footnote linking to residency FAQ: https://redwood.company/residency-faq

devon: one last ask — call out SDK min version (>= v1.3.0) in the sample so users know the region enum exists.

marta: updated PR description to require SDK >= v1.3.0.

ana: I'll run a quick i18n sweep to ensure translators don't localize header names.

marta: appreciated. Leaving merge to devon after CI + i18n sweep. :white_check_mark:
